title: Open Neuromorphic Initiatives Directory
summary: This resource lists ongoing community initiatives within the Open Neuromorphic ecosystem focused on neuromorphic computing. Current efforts include live coding sessions for software development and contributions to hardware/software directories by specific individuals. Past contributors supported the initial conception of the organization. The page serves as a central hub for resources, news, and collaboration but does not specify project dates or Technology Readiness Levels.
tldr: Directory listing Open Neuromorphic community initiatives covering live coding sessions, resource development, and past foundational contributions to neuromorphic computing.
evidence: This page highlights some of the key ongoing initiatives that individuals are leading to foster growth, education, and collaboration within the neuromorphic field.
Current Initiatives Contributors: Justin Riddiough, Alexandre Marcireau, Effiong Blessing The elected Executive Committee of Open Neuromorphic
Live coding sessions exploring neuromorphic software, tackling challenges, and discussing the latest in neuromorphic development.
